summary: Comprehensive testing of QueueIt Venue Filters feature. All 10 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified admin dashboard with Venue Filters section (5 preset buttons, mode toggle, genre/mood chips) on both desktop and mobile. Customer page shows genre filter chips and 'Fine Dining Vibe — Filtered' indicator when strict mode is active.

Backend: PUT /api/filters mode toggle switches between strict and open
Backend: PUT /api/filters with custom genres creates custom filter
Backend: PUT /api/filters all 5 presets can be applied
Backend: GET /api/songs/search works without genre parameter

context_for_next_testing_agent: Venue Filters feature fully tested. Endpoints: GET /api/filters (public), GET /api/filters/presets (public), PUT /api/filters (requires Bearer hostel2024 auth). Admin dashboard has VENUE FILTERS section below QR Generator. Mobile view has 6 tabs including FILTER tab. Customer page at /request shows genre chips when filters are active and 'Filtered' indicator when strict mode is on. Search endpoint /api/songs/search accepts optional genre parameter. Set localStorage 'queueit_onboarding_done' to 'true' to skip onboarding.
